name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 5
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: PACK Run: Social
description:
PACK is well known for being one of the best social group rides on Zwift. But did you know that some Packers also like to...run?! That's right! You can now join your favorite group as we put down our bikes and pick up our running shoes.

The PACK social run is a 30 minute, relaxed pace 5k with several pace groups to fit your needs. Please choose the pace group you are most likely to stick with. This is NOT a race.

All runners are welcome to join the event and enjoy the friendly supportive atmosphere.

Facebook Group: #zwiftpack
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftpack/

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Urumaze
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? 
For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

name: Team Italy Spicy Coffee Italian Ride
description:
Se cerchi la giusta compagnia per prepararti al fine settimana sei nel posto giusto.
Lo scopo della SPICY COFFEE ITALIAN RIDE è quello di stare tutti insieme, sfruttare la scia del gruppo e fare due chiacchiere ad un ritmo medio fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg per 90 minuti, il late join è attivo per 30 minuti.
Questa NON è una gara.
Segui le istruzioni dei leader(giallo) per un gruppo compatto.
Ricordati di non superare la fence (barra rossa) altrimenti verrai eliminato.
Partecipa a questa ride per sbloccare la divisa del team italy.
BUONA PEDALATA A TUTTI
TEAM ITALY organizza una vasta gamma di eventi, tutti con le seguenti regole:
-in una pedalata di categoria D, alcuni ciclisti sono principianti, segui le istruzioni del
leader (logo giallo) che appaiono come testo al centro e tieni presente che il ritmo sarà fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg
-Il valore w/kg sarà diverso per tutti voi, il motivo principale sarà il peso, seguito dalla
capacità di utilizzare la scia e l'equipaggiamento della vostra bici in gioco
-abilitare i messaggi nelle opzioni zwift, fondamentali per una buona esperienza
-le pedalate della categoria D sono facili per un ciclista con C alto, 3w/kg ftp, impegnative per un C basso, 2.5 w/kg ftp, estreme per un ciclista D con 2 w/kg FTP, lo stesso per le
corse C, facili per un A, 4w/kg ftp, impegnative per B 3.2 w/kg ftp, ed estreme per C con 2.5
w/kg ftp.


Are you looking for the perfect companion and you are training for the weekend? This is the right place.
Spicy Coffee Italian Ride's goal is to stay together, enjoy the group draft, and have a bit of easy chat at an average pace between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg for 90 minutes, late join is enabled for 30 minutes.
This is NOT A RACE.


Follow the leaders' instructions (yellow beacons) to keep the group tight.
Remember the Fence is KILLER, 60 seconds over and you'll be out of the event.
Join this ride to unlock the Team Italy Jersey.
TEAM ITALY organizes a wide range of events, which all agree to the following rules:
- in a D category ride, some riders are beginners, and follow the leader's instructions (yellow
beacon) that appear as text in the middle and keep in mind that the pace will be between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg


-The w/kg value will be different for all of you, the main reason will be weight, followed by the
capacity to use the draft and your in-game bike equipment
- enable the messages in Zwift options, fundamental for a great experience
- D category's rides are easy for a high C rider, 3wkg ftp, challenging for a low C, 2.5 w/kg
FTP, is extreme for a D rider with 2 w/kg FTP, same for C rides, easy for an A, 4 w/kg ftp,
challenging for B's, 3.2 w/kg ftp, and extreme for C's 2.5 w/kg ftp.
- if you have any suggestions please let us know

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: WKG 2for1 DOWN UNDER
description:
Get ready for a full-throttle 60-minute group ride that’s guaranteed to deliver big fun and even bigger watts!
The YELLOW BEACON will be rolling at a punchy 2.0 w/kg average — perfect pace for chatting, laughing, and smashing it together. Expect a friendly sprint competition mid-ride to get the legs firing… and of course, the one and only WORLD FAMOUS WKG MINI-RACE FINISH where we crown the legends at the line! 🏆
Pro tips for maximum fun:
• Stick with the Yellow Beacon for the full group-ride magic
• Dad jokes are not just allowed — they’re highly encouraged 😂
• Finish the ride and unlock the seriously awesome WKG One11 jersey as your reward!
Dropped off the back? No stress! Just shout for help and our legendary RED BEACON CREW will swing back, pick you up, and get you straight back into the action — as long as you’re putting in the effort with them.
This is going to be an absolute blast. See you Down Under — let’s make this one unforgettable! 🇦🇺

If you find yourself off the back please ask for assistance......our awesome RED BEACON CREW, will help you get back to the group, providing you make the effort with them.

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Mech Isle Loop
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: The Herd Thunder Down Under
description:
Join us for a relaxed social ride with The Herd Thunder Down Under and Aussie Herdlings. Let's improve our mindsets and release some stress from your day. We’re stronger together. 

Average pace will be 1.6w/kg to 2.0w/kg.
You’re welcome to sprint, just start behind the leader and regroup after. All riders are welcome to join. We have sweepers to help, if you fall off the pace. Stronger riders are encouraged to help sweep. This is NOT A RACE!
We are a supportive community and our goal is to encourage new riders to join.

Please join us on Discord during the ride, and our community at http://theherd.club/

name: Ascenders Banded Brunch Bunch Ride
description:
Welcome to [ASC] - Ascenders Brunch Bunch for a chilled Rubber Banded ride around the virtual roads of Zwift.  Each week the course will vary so whether you’re a beginner just starting out on your first group rides, this is a great way to start. If recovering from injury, or just looking for a steady paced ride then come and join us. We aim to provide a safe encouraging ride for you to enjoy. You’ll be very welcome in the Brunch Bunch


This is a banded group ride and not a race. As long as you keep spinning you will stay with the group. If you’re looking for an easy ride then sit in the group near the Yellow Lead Beacon. However if you’re feeling strong then head to the front and help pull the group along.


Please note this ride is not fenced.

name: Run 10K Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the longest running daily led running event on Zwift. This was the event that kickstarted the NoblePro Running Club in support of a world record attempt at consecutive daily10k runs.
The event has a healthy group of leaders who are friendly and chatty and will help you achieve your goal, not matter your experience. Feel free to join in the chat and become addicted like we all are.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 10k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, each day of the week there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/

https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Thursday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Thursdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. name: The Chop by AHDR
description:
AHDR THE CHOP

Being "in the chop" is an Aussie expression that you won't read about in the UCI rulebook. It's one of the many nuances of bike racing that only comes with experience.

Sometimes when you're in a race and find yourself in the final break-away bunch you might get asked "are we in the chop?" or "are we chopping it?". This is referring to collusion between the lead riders to work together until the finish. Many times a break-away will be doomed in the final kilometres because everyone starts playing cat and mouse, attacking, sitting up, etc.

But all that goes out the window in the last lap. This is generally where the group comes together and the final push begins. Working together goes out the window and is every man or woman for themselves for the final sprint to the line.

AHDR The Chop is a flat fast time-based handicap race. Do you always get blown out the back on the start of a multi grade race trying to hang onto the guy going with A grade pushing 5w/kg. Well not on The Chop. Released in Grades there are time splits from D to A with the intention of all coming together at the end for the big finish. Each Grade wears a different AHDR/Zwift kit making each grade easily identifiable on who's wheel you want to catch if they go past.

Races happen on Thursday evenings. We plan to add further races in the future. No single race has been the same. Many variables are at play on The Chop including course (which is generally a flat course), race numbers, and the inevitable sandbaggers. It has been called a team time trail and cat and mouse but the real racers know it only as "THE CHOP". Do you have what it takes to take the glory?

A Grade – AHDR GIANT Kit
B Grade – HDR Kit
C Grade – Fluoro Pink
D Grade – Fluoro Camo

#ahdr #cyclingaustralia

description:
Join QT2 Systems for a challenging hour-long session, each Thursday morning at 5:15 AM EST, around some of the best routes on Zwift. Each 60-minute ride includes a quick warm-up and cool down. These workouts are designed to challenge and make you stronger along the way. One of our coaches is present, each week, to answer questions, motivate, and encourage riders throughout the entire workout.

With ZWIFT’s ride banding, these workouts are suitable for athletes of all levels, regardless of fitness level. That’s right, we are all “rubber-banded” together, relative to percentage of rider FTP.

QT2 Systems is one of the world’s premier triathlon coaching brands, and parent company to OutRival Racing, The Cycling Formula, The Core Diet, The Run Formula, and Cycle Life Studios.

name: 5K Down Under
description:
Join us for a 5k group run led by Australian age-group triathlete Ben Shepherd. Ben is an avid triathlete and Zwifter who - like many of us - balances his training with work and family. He's a thirty-something father of a young daughter and credits triathlon with helping him lose over 50lb (25kg). He's a Ironman World Championships finisher (2016) and has qualified to represent his native Australia at the ITU Age-Group World Championships in September of this year.

After suffering a tendon injury to his patella (kneecap), he's working back to fitness with 100% treadmill running and is happy to have some company! Join him for a relaxed pace 5K. Come just to run or to chat about triathlon, Zwift, or where to get the best flat whites. Ben will be leading at 5:30/km (8:50/mi) pace, but feel free to join in at your own pace. This is a social run, not a race, so leave the racing flats at home for now.

name: GRIT Tempo-ish Thursday
description:
This is a group ride that has competitive sprint segments. Although not mandatory, riders are encouraged to participate in sprints. After each sprint we quickly regroup and continue the tempo paced lap. The motto of the ride has always been "Faster and farther together". Come have fun with us as we train to improve sprinting capability.

We ride a course that is approx. 5 km (3 miles) and we continue laps for 60 minutes. Each lap has a timed sprint zone and we sprint at this area on each lap for about 7 sprints in the 60 minute ride.

The tempo pace is around 3.0 w/kg and we normally have a large peloton of 30+ riders moving at this pace.

Sprints are short duration (10 - 30 seconds) and will be competitive as riders use maximum power to compete for the fastest sprint time.

name: Phoenix Rising As One
description:
Please join us on Phoenix Rising As One and, at least for a little while, overcome some of those annoying real life stresses. Phoenix Rising As One is a joyful social group ride. We welcome riders of all types and strengths to join us for an hour of fun and camaraderie. 

The yellow beacon will attempt to ride at a pace of between 1.5 and 1.8 w/kg.  There will be no fence and we welcome riders to ride at whatever pace they want – the objective of the ride is to be together which we are via text and discord.  And we will have a fab group of sweepers to accompany and inspire riders who wish to ride at a gentler pace.  We intend that no one ride alone unless they want to.

We will ride a variety of routes, attempting to cover some of the less traveled routes in Zwift and earning the occasional badge.  We will ride flattish routes although some nasty shorter climbs or non paved surfaces will inevitably be included. 

So wherever you are located, please join us for a rollicking fun hour of cycling.

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/mNMva8ekJR
Check us out on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/615972979730125/

name: CRYO-GEN: The Tempo Split
description:
Push your limits, find your rhythm.
Welcome to The Tempo Split, a dynamic tempo session designed to help you build aerobic power and endurance. This isn’t just a group ride; it’s a choose-your-own-adventure workout where you decide how deep to dig.

How it Works
We all start together in a single pen for a 10-20 minute progressive warm-up at a controlled, social pace. Once the warm-up is complete, the “Split” begins.
The Yellow Beacon (Lead): Will begin intervals at a high-tempo pace of 3.2 – 3.5 w/kg. This is for those looking to challenge their sustained power.
The Red Beacon (Sweep): Will begin intervals at a steady tempo pace of 2.7 – 3.0 w/kg. This is the safety net for those who want a solid workout without going “into the red.”

The Challenge
Start with the Yellow Beacon. Your goal is to hold that higher intensity for as long as possible. If the effort becomes unsustainable or your heart rate climbs too high, don’t worry—simply ease back to the Red Beacon following behind and finish the interval with that group.

Course & Intensity Notes
Please note that this is a flexible training session:
Terrain Impact: The ride format and group cohesion may change based on the route’s profile. Expect paces to shift slightly on climbs or descents.
Variable Intervals: Interval intensity and duration are subject to change week-to-week based on the specific goals of the session and the total distance of the chosen course.

Pro Tip: Use the draft! Whether you’re with the Yellow or Red group, staying tucked in a pack will help you maintain these tempo zones more efficiently.
Pro Tip: Keep an eye on the on-screen chat. The Beacons will announce interval starts, finishes, and any adjustments to the target w/kg based on the terrain.

Ride Rules
Be Kind: This is a supportive training environment.
Listen to your body: There is no shame in dropping back to the Red Beacon; that’s exactly why it’s there!
Stay Predictable: Avoid sudden surges so the groups can stay formed.

description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way!

name: DWGZ — Hollentour
description:
DWGZ — Höllentour

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Höllentour — hell tour, German-style — is our Thursday ride with teeth. It's a step up from a standard endurance spin, with some real climbing worked in to keep the legs honest. This ride brings the heat early in the week without going full suffer-fest — just enough vert to earn your Thursday.

Whether you're building climbing strength, chasing a harder effort before the weekend, or just want to ride with people who'll push you and laugh with you at the same time, this one's for you.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steady climbing pressure, smooth rotation, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, turn up the heat, and ride through the Höllentour with us.

name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

name: Japan ZWIFT Hill Climb Race
description:
Welcome to the Japan Zwift Hill Climb Race!
This race is intended to provide an Hill Climb race on Thursdays
Let's enjoy!! All are welcome. 

POWER UPs:Not allowed
BIKES:All allowed

GROUPS:
Use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg then pick the correct group:
A:4.0 W/kg FTP or higer
B:3.2 W/kg to 4.0W/kg FTP
C:2.5 W/kg to 3.1W/kg FTP
D:Under2.4 W/kg FTP

Have Fun! Ride On!


Japan ZWIFT Hill Climb Race 

毎週木曜日に開催のヒルクライムレースになります。
Watopiaの「Epic KOM」「Volcano KOM」などのKOMルートをはじめとする多数のルートで
日本人ヒルクライマーが多数参戦し全てのカテゴリーの方が楽しめるレース展開に!?

世界中のZwifterと競い合うことでワークアウト以上の刺激とトレーニング効果が期待できます。

Zwifterの参加をお待ちしています。

POWER UPs:アイテム使用不可
BIKES:全ての自転車を選択可能

カテゴリーに関して
あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○w/kg】となります。
例：FTP250W、体重60kgの方は4.166w/kgになりますのでAカテゴリーを選択下さい。

FTPとはサイクリストが1時間を通して維持できるパワーになります。
FTPの数値がわからない方はZwift Workout内のFTPテストで計測出来ます。

A:4.0 W/kg FTP 以上の方
B:3.2 W/kg～4.0W/kg FTPの方
C:2.5 W/kg～3.1W/kg FTPの方
D:2.4 W/kg FTP以下の方

Have Fun! Ride On!!

hard racing.

name: SROZ's Contenders, Pretenders, & Rear-Enders
description:
Whether you’re a Tour de France hopeful, a procrastinating amateur, or the person whose front tire spends a suspicious amount of time in someone else’s rear derailleur...we honestly don't care!

There are no "real" awards for winning a climb or clinching a sprint. If you’re looking for a trophy, try a middle school soccer tournament.

The goal is to maintain a steady engine...smooth rotations and clean pulls. Even when the profile gets punchy or the wind shifts, we're staying "dialed in" on 18–20 mph (30–32 kph).

Feeling a little gapped? Don't sweat it. We strive to have a dedicated sweeper on every ride to help pull you back into the fold.

The "Gene Autry" Philosophy: We believe in freedom! As the legend himself said, we won’t fence you in.

At the end of the day, you’re the captain of your own bike. Whether you’re pushing the pace or soaking in the scenery: ride your ride!

So come out, enjoy the virtual fresh air, and keep the faith!

eventSubgroups.name: SROZ's Contenders, Pretenders, & Rear-Enders (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
We don’t care if you’re a contender, pretender, or rear-ender!  We just enjoy riding with others in a fun, social group. 

There are no “real” awards for being first on a climb or on a sprint during our rides, only the satisfaction of being able to ride a bike for just one more day! 

The pace may vary depending on the course, but we will strive to ride and socialize with an overall average pace of approximately 18-20mph (30-32kph).  

We will try to have a sweeper on each ride to help any rider who may want to return to the group. 

Also, we will be applying the Gene Autry philosophy…we won’t fence you in!

Remember, the choice is yours…ride your ride!

So, enjoy your ride, keep the faith, and become that someone!

name: BMTR Chase Adventure
description:
The BMTR Chase Adventure event encourages participants to explore their personal power map, focusing on Zones 3 and 4, while fostering collaboration and support among teammates. 

Ride Leaders will oversee Team Categories B, C, and D to ensure they maintain the advertised average pace while optimizing each group's efforts. Team Category A will be responsible for self-organization.

**How The Chase Is Set Up**
Teams will start at intervals: Team D first, followed by C, B, and A. The aim is for A, B, and C to catch up to the teams that started ahead by working together. If faster teams catch up to slower ones, riders from the slower teams have the option to join the faster group to increase their effort; if they can't keep up, they can return to their original group and try again next week!

**You Can Switch Teams During The Event**
You have a 30-minute Late Join period to switch teams if your current team isn't at your desired pace.

**How The W/KG Ranges Are Calculated For Each Category**
The average watts-per-kilogram (w/kg) pace ranges specified for each team represent the overall average for the entire event. During the event, teams may exceed or fall below this range. The average pace for each category is designed to keep most riders at effort levels corresponding to Zones 3 and 4. It is assumed that each rider selects a category that accurately reflects both their Functional Threshold Power (FTP) and their Zwift-assigned category.

We look forward to having you join us!

description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

description:

description:
This week's ride unlocks the H2O Audio headphones in game. Like the look? The sound is great, too! Pick up a real-life set at https://zwiftinsider.com/h2o, using discount code ZWIFTINSIDER for 20% off.

Each week we spin through 100km of pristine Zwift roads, rotating between flattish routes to keep the endurance training fast and fun. Burn those pizza slices, chat about all things Zwift/cycling, and build your base with ride leader Eric Schlange, creator of Zwift Insider!

PACE:
Eric will ride at ~2.5w/kg/210W for an average speed of 37-39kph (23-24mph). Join his yellow beacon group to ride at the stated pace, join the "zinners" up the road for something spicier, or do whatever keeps you motivated.

Longer rides always pass faster with voice chat, so join us on Discord if you're able! Find us at https://discord.gg/zwiftinsider

You will unlock the Zwift Insider kit upon finishing this event.

description:
Transform Your Winter with Endurance Nation’s OutSeason Program!

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

Why settle for base miles alone when you can add targeted intensity this winter? Join Endurance Nation and see what a season of smart training can do. Discover more about the OutSeason at www.endurancenation.us/zwift.

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides on Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays each week — they are great alternates to these scheduled workouts!

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 12
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: Virginia's Blue Ridge TWENTY28 Road to LA
description:
Virginia’s Blue Ridge TWENTY28 are now in our 20th year of operation developing high-performance athletes and the next generation of competitive cyclists. Success in aligning student-athletes with college scholarships through cycling. Support of the multi-discipline athlete. Adaptive, dynamic, versatile, resilient, and committed to growing diversity in the landscape of women’s cycling.

When the team was formed in 2005, The goal of TWENTY12 was to create a pathway for athletes to the 2012 London Olympics. London resulted in two Olympic medals; gold and silver, the only U.S based road program to achieve this. The team replicated its success with 5 medals in Rio 2016 Olympics/Paralympics, two in Tokyo, two in Paris 2024, and now on to LA 2028.

Ride Leaders + Sweepers include
Amanda Coker who is a level 100 Zwifter and is an accomplished ultra-endurance IRL athlete: World Record Holder - 86,573.2 miles ridden in a year - yes that’s riding 237 miles per day for 365 straight days

Sweepers include members of Virginia’s Blue Ridge TWENTY24 Pro Cycling and regulars are team founder Nicola Cranmer and TWENTY24 eSports captain Kristin Kulchinsky

name: Applewood Cycling Group Ride
description:
Established in September 2020, The Applewood Cycling Group Ride is surely one of the longest continually running weekly group rides on Zwift. Join leader Stephen Collins for a challenging B+ tempo training ride in the lavender fields of France covering two full laps of the Douce route. Our ride incorporates both a steady group with the leader targeting pulls on the front at 3.5 to 3.9 WKG (drafting average ~3.2wkg), and we offer an all-out A+ pace breakaway group. Our breakaway is fully sanctioned and an important element of our group ride dynamic. Every now and then the beacon group catches the break, but only very rarely. No fence, proud. No sweep. We do honor the finish line with a competitive sprint!

We encourage friendly group banter during the ride. Our goal is to create an outstanding training ride that is social and entertaining. Thanks to all our wonderful regulars and a big welcome to all newcomers.

name: Team DRAFT Thursday Race
description:
Welcome to the Thursday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!
We encourage that all participants head over to zwiftpower.com and register. For more information see: https://zwiftinsider.com/zwiftpower-signup/ Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration will not be included in the official race results. We also ask that your Zwift activities be saved publicly, and that you open and maintain a Strava account to allow for organizer analysis. Any rider exhibiting questionable performance during a the race may be disqualified.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series
description: Starting on Tuesday 22nd October at 06:30 MST, join RAAM World Record Holder Lucas Clarke for the Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series on Zwift. These weekly sessions are crafted to help you develop your endurance capacity.  Whether you’re preparing for ultra-distance events like Race Across America (RAAM), Transcontinental and Mallorca 312, aiming for your first ultra or looking to refine your training, this series is your key to mastering endurance.

name: Stanga Racing Punchy Thursdays
description:
Stanga Racing Punchy Thursdays is your weekly dose of short climbs, sharp surges, and leg-burning repeats. Expect a fast rolling course with plenty of chances to attack, close gaps, and test your VO2.
Pick the right category, race fair, and bring your best punch – this one is designed to hurt, not to last all night.

Like this format? Join the Stanga Racing club on Zwift for our full weekly schedule of crits, punchy races, and endurance rides.

https://www.zwift.com/clubs/12f0e125-1fb8-4d78-8da2-b39efca4bffb/home

name: 🔥 SWX Thursday Threshold – by Coach Cindy 🚀
description:
Push your limits every Thursday with SWX Threshold — a focused effort session built to improve your FTP and race performance.
Designed by Coach Cindy (Train Smart = Race Stronger), this session targets sustained high-intensity intervals just below or at threshold. It’s not easy, but it works. Bring your grit, legs, and a full bottle.

• All levels welcome
• Stay-together mode enabled

name: DBR Base Endurance Ride
description:
Join the Danish Bike Riders for an endurance workout that will boost your aerobic threshold and train your body to use fat as energy rather than quickly depleting your glycogen stores. Continual efforts will boost your race performance and endurance.

This ride will have a ride leader, but the point is that everyone rides at their own level.

Stay in the blue power zone (zone 2) for the duration of the workout. You will quickly form grupettos with people of your own fitness level.

To bring up the power graph, press G on your PC or Mac. Tap the screen and the graph icon for IOS and Android.

E category - But 1.0-5.0 W/kg avg.

Official site : Danish Bike Riders - https://www.facebook.com/DanishBikeRiders

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

#dbr

name: Epic Run Crew: Thursday Thunder
description:
It’s nearing the end of the work week. Perhaps it’s time to pick up the pace and go for it? Bring on the thunderous feet!

This is a 45 minute group run. You are welcome to run at your own pace (AYOP). Feel free to continue running after you finish the 45 minutes, or end it early. It’s up to you.

Chatting is encouraged! Talk about food. Make a funny observation. Whatever. We don’t judge. Just have some fun!

Epic Run Crew is based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. We were founded as an in-person club in 2021 and then joined Zwift in June 2022.

Use the Zwift Companion app to join the Epic Run Crew club, for access to exclusive member-only group runs.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 13
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.

Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides on Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays each week — they are great alternates to these scheduled workouts!

description:
Time to fire up those legs! Every Thursday the SYN Global Cycling Club brings you the SYN Workout Hour—a weekly session built to boost your fitness and keep you sweating with a smile. We will perform a workout to complement your overall ride schedule with threshold-building session, personalized to your in-game FTP. Join us and let us get stronger together.

60MIN NO DROP WORKOUT

UNLOCK THE SYNDICATE CLUB KIT

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

Join the FMR Run Club for more fun events at https://www.zwift.com/uk/clubs/6afca04c-8fac-4ffa-b700-f27a73d7f3dd/join

description:
Back in January 2021, Eddie Izzard ran 32 marathons in 31 days. Our community rallied together and joined the action all month long. This inspired us to create the MHG Run Club, which continues Eddie’s incredible efforts of making humanity great.

The MHG Run Club motivates and supports everybody, whether you’re looking for tips to achieve your training goals or looking for a group to bond and socialize with. A light-minded Zwift treadmill runners group, for runners of all abilities, friendly chat and a good laugh :)

Please feel free to join me Clive Finnimore with our official MHG Run Club Lunchtime 5K @ 8KPH on Monday, Wednesday & Fridays, See you there soon :)

name: Vitality for UNICEF Group Ride
description:
Vitality, in partnership with UNICEF, is teaming up with Zwift for a series of great social rides for a fantastic cause. Don’t miss out. Join our social rides of 45 minutes to one hour and do your part to give kids a head start. Keeping you active and helping Vitality and UNICEF vaccinate millions of children worldwide.

We encourage everyone to stay together for this social ride. Every ride completion will help UNICEF vaccinate a child against polio.

About Vitality:
 
Guided by a core purpose of making people healthier, Vitality is the leader in shared-value by creating healthy behavior changes in insurance. By blending technology, data, incentives, and behavioural science, Vitality inspires healthy changes in individuals and organizations. 

In partnership with UNICEF, Vitality aims to vaccinate millions of children against polio by donating vaccines on behalf of participants who complete the Vitality for UNICEF Ride series events.

Furthermore, the partnership with Zwift has been established as part of Vitality’s global pledge to get 100 million people 20% more active by 2025 through incentives to live healthier, more active lifestyles.

This is not a race and we encourage you to stay with the ride leader (yellow beacon) if you are feeling strong,  you are more than welcome to assist with sweeping duties at the back of the ride helping dropped riders rejoin the group. We are looking forward to hosting you for the ride.

name: We Ride Paris with Clement Braz Afonso
description:
Clément Braz Afonso is a French professional road cyclist riding for UCI WorldTeam Groupama–FDJ. Known for his attacking style and frequent appearances in breakaways, he achieved the biggest result of his professional career to date by winning the mountains classification at the Tour Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes.

Join Zwifters from all over the world for WE RIDE PARIS, where we’re teaming up with football club Paris Saint-Germain for a celebration of sport like no other. 

Complete the Crêpe Escape route as part of the We Ride Paris in-game challenge—live or on demand—to unlock the exclusive We Ride Paris kit and socks. You’ll also be able to enter for a chance to attend the in-person event at Parc des Princes, the iconic home of Paris Saint-Germain.

And there’s more up for grabs. Complete the challenge for a shot at prizes, including a Zwift Ride, WHOOP band with a 1-year membership, Paris Saint-Germain gift voucher, and more.

Every We Ride Paris Live Ride also puts the special-edition Wilier x Paris Saint-Germain Filante SLR ID2 in the spotlight. Its PSG-designed finish blends electric blue, vivid violet, and crisp white into a colorway that looks as fast as it rides.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 17
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.

Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: NoPinz R3R - Double Crit 1/2
description:
Welcome to this NoPinz R3R Race. The rules are simple....
Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.
Cats A, and B will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor.
Cat C will require power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor for podium spots.
Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual (power) record and to make analysis publicly available on ZwiftPower; they must also be using a direct drive trainer or power meter.
**Elite level performances are also expected to be supported by dual (power) recordings from reputable power sources or easily verifiable outside data. This applies to those with a history of such performances.
** 5.2 w/kg (20 mins); 6 w/kg (5 mins); 9.8 w/kg (1 min)
Zwift Activities must be saved publicly.
Please also maintain an open and active Strava profile to facilitate organiser inquiry.
Please see http://www.zwiftpower.com for finalised race results. The race is brought to you by NoPinz please visit https://nopinz.com/product-tag/subzero/ All subzero kit can be custom made in any design.

name: Hexa'Quiz Ride
description:
[FRANÇAIS]
HEXA'Quiz Ride, c'est une compétition sympa où on combine vélo et culture
générale. On pédale tranquillement tout en répondant à des questions sur
l'appli Kahoot! Tous les 4/5 kilomètres, une question arrive. Celui qui
répond bien et vite gagne.

On organise également un classement mensuel pour ajouter un peu de piquant
à l'aventure.

Les questions portent sur divers aspects du cyclisme : les exploits des
professionnels, les différents types de vélos, l'univers virtuel de Zwift,
et tout ce qui touche de près ou de loin à cette passionnante discipline
sportive.

Venez vous amuser et défier vos amis ! Que le meilleur gagne ! C'est le
moment de montrer vos connaissances tout en pédalant !

[ENGLISH]
HEXA'Quiz Ride is a fun competition combining cycling and general
knowledge. You pedal quietly while answering questions on the Kahoot! app.
Every 4/5 kilometers, a question comes up. Whoever answers well and quickly
wins.

A monthly ranking is also organized to add a little spice to the adventure.

The questions focus on various aspects of cycling: the exploits of the
professionals, the different types of bikes, the virtual world of Zwift,
and anything else related to this exciting sport.

Come and have fun and challenge your friends! May the best man win! It's
time to show off your knowledge while you pedal!

name: SZR Group Workout by Thyr
description:
Ride with Mattias Thyr at Ovning.se in courtesy of SZR as he makes workouts for the one who cares and lets him.
Nudging the grit! The home of the unstructured GWOs. Here you got motivating rides together with friends. Skip plans, just a exercise your pixels in a group is good for you, both mentally and physically. Every 6th week we do a #maxtjuga (as we say in Sweden) or a the 20min FTP test together.

On his 8th years and +350 GWO:s he created and lead personally on Zwift. Come join and, "Aim for the stars!

• The workout is approximately 60 minutes long and can be done either fasted or fueled. I personally recommend lots of sugars.
• The goal is to explore and feel the differences between various fueling strategies.
• Remember to adjust your calorie intake to match your energy needs before during and after the session.
• This workout is based on a percentage of your FTP (Functional Threshold Power).
• Ensure your FTP is accurate and up-to-date for the best experience.
• If needed, perform an FTP Test a day before on Zwift prior the workout.
• Use the Zwift Companion App or the Page Up/Down keys on your computer to adjust the FTP bias by 10% up or 25% down, helping you dial in the effort level to suit your preferences.

description:

This is HISP’s most challenging and exigent event, now in its fifth edition.

We will race 13 stages in 14 days, starting on August 24th. There will be four starts each day, so you can choose whichever fits your schedule best. You can even repeat a stage, but only your best time will count for the General Classification (GC).

Serán trece etapas en catorce días, arrancando el 24 de agosto. Contaremos con cuatro salidas diarias para que puedas escoger la que mejor te convenga. Puedes repetir la etapa si lo deseas, pero solamente contará tu mejor tiempo para la Clasificación General (GC).

name: PUMP: Loop Logic IV — Thursday (4 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: Team AMANI's Safari Ride
description:
Team AMANI's Safari Ride is an all category ride, organized by Team AMANI as a training and community engagement tool. Come train with the up and coming talent from East Africa!

Want to ride alongside some of the future stars of the gravel peloton? You've come to the right place! The routes may differ weekly and the rides will be periodically attended by the stars of  Team Amani as well as the future stars from our training facilities in Rwanda (Spoke Academy) and Kenya (the Amani House). We also welcome supporters of Team Amani to join and lead / take part.

So make sure to bring your A-game. There are 3 categories leaving from the start pen and everyone is able to sign-up according to their category and ride with the bunch. Challenge yourself on the segments we come across and make sure to set that PR!

Our goal is to stay as a group during the warming up, work hard at the climbs and regroup on the descents. We will break into a couple of different groups, so find your pace and grab a wheel. If you're feeling strong, pull a few friends across the flats to the hill.

So what is the AMANI Project? The AMANI project brings together initiatives aimed at enhancing access to the sport of cycling and creating opportunities for riders based in  East Africa. Our initiatives are:
- Team AMANI 
- Migration Gravel Race & Safari Gravel
- Amani House & Spoke Academy

Want to learn more or support the cause?

Follow us on our socials:

@teamamani
@spokeacademy

https://www.teamamani.com/

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 1/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Race Times (Italian Time): 19:05, 19:25, 19:45, and 20:05.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

For technical support or team registrations, contact the organizers at

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 21
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

☀️We’re now in the spring and summer season.☀️
Some of our events will stay in the calendar, but there may be times when our ride leaders won’t be there. If that happens, we’d really appreciate it if you could still ride according to the plan of the event.
Our ZTPL Cycling Club events will be back in autumn 2026.
For now — RIDE ON, enjoy the good weather, and if you can’t, just have a great time at our events.

We would like to invite you to ZTPL Cycling Club Coffee Ride.
In order to ride with Coffee Ride pace, please choose your group wisely.

Our rides are usually led by leaders who help keep the peloton in check. If there is no leader during the event, try to stick to the pace we agreed on when you joined the selected group.
◾️Group E is for total beginners with easy pace at around 1.3-1.7 wk/g
◾️Group D is a beginner group. The pace is calm, we learn how to ride in a Zwift peleton with 1.8-2.5 w/kg pace
◾️Group C is between group D and more advanced Group B. Pace 2.7-3.2 w/kg.
Important: If your FTP is around 2.5w/kg, this group will not be for you

◾️Please listen to the leader’s commands which are displayed in yellow during the whole ride. The leader who leads the group is highlighted in yellow. Please don’t pass the leader.
◾️Please follow the leader instructions! Especially if the leader notices that the group has been swept away. The leader is highlighted in yellow.
◾️At the and wait for the leader’s command: GOGOGO and start your sprint. Enjoy!

name: ZZRC Soft Spin 1.5 with Andi
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Soft Spin 1.5 with Andi.  This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift.

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride, with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints, but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced.

In the event of falling off the back of the main group, you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch.

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process.

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club, but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies.

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you.

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group.

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON.

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel

https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS

Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

Most important of all… HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: The HERD Thursday Social
description:
New to Zwift, just a little out of shape or recovering from injury? This is the group ride for you! All are welcome to join The Herd on this supportive and social event.

Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. This is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.

WE DO RUN THE FENCE! The fence is in place to ensure that new group riders don't get caught up with the flyers and have a bad experience. Bear in mind that the fence will move due to changes in speed on the inclines. We ask that you always ride with the yellow beacon. Please pay attention to messages from the ride leader regarding fence intervals and when to regroup.

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/Dr7ZtPV (Please use Push-To-Talk)
Check us out on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerd/

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 2/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Race Times (Italian Time): 19:05, 19:25, 19:45, and 20:05.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

For technical support or team registrations, contact the organizers at 

Official Sites: * www.tsezwift.com * www.epicasport.com

name: Hotchillee Gain Train
description:
What is it?
Firstly, IT’S NOT A RACE but that doesn’t mean it’s an easy pace no-drop ride. It’s a paced “Category +” Hare and Hounds where you will be working predominately at the upper end of your category and hanging on for as long as you can in search of those gains.

What are the paces?
Paces are based on what the Ride Leader for each group will average and our leaders are pretty accurate - check on ZwiftPower afterwards.   Buffet Class (D+) Leader will average 2.4 w/kg (departs at 1830)
Second Class (C+) Leader average 3.1 w/kg (departs at 1834)
First Class (B+) Leader will average 3.7 w/kg (departs at 1836)

Please do not push the pace faster than this, it ruins it for everyone - respect your Ride Leader, do what they ask and don’t sandbag.

Will the groups catch each other?
Usually we aim for there to be a catch/merge in the final 5km or so but this does depend on the course.
If a merge does happen, stronger riders are encouraged to “upgrade” to the faster group and, if you’re struggling, you can also “downgrade” to a slower one.

What if I get dropped?
Suck it up, maybe find someone to spin home with and try to hang on a bit longer next week - just like a IRL chain-gang, that’s how you get stronger.

Can I push it at the end?
With about 3km to go, your Leader will give a Go! Go! Go! shout and then, if you want, you can empty the tank.

  What is Hotchillee?
Hotchillee is both an events company that organises some of the world's best cycling events and a cycling community. Check out the website for details of events, rides and to get involved www.hotchillee.com

name: ZHCC RUBBERBAND CLUB
description:
Want a 100% guaranteed no drop ride? want a 100% guarantee you can ride at your own pace? want a 100% guarantee you WILL stay in the group,? want a 100% guarantee that the nasty fence will NOT kick you...........THEN LOOK NO FURTHER, this is the ride for you.
Try it - YOU MIGHT JUST LIKE IT!
Our ZHCC Rubber Band Club has the “rubber-band” activated which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.
The ride speed will be slightly less than you would normally experience in a group ride due to the rubber band effect, but we feel that's a small price to pay to allow all level of riders to remain together throughout the ride.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO CC race series.  Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: ZLDR Progression Event
description:
Welcome to our ZLDR Progression Event. Today we’re going to do a progression run, which basically starts a run at a slower pace and finishes at a faster pace than you started. So we’ll get progressively faster with each split. Progression runs help us build our endurance base but with less stress on our bodies than a typical interval or tempo run. This can help reduce the risk of injury. Plus it helps break up the monotony in our training.

Progression running also will help teach you smarter pacing, starting conservatively so you don’t burn out too soon. It also will help train your body to get used to pushing harder at the end of a race.

This event will start with a 10 minute warm up followed by 4 x 5 mins splits. The first split will be at 10k pace and each split will be a stair step up at +2%. Finally we will cool down for 10 minutes. So let’s get those shoes laced up and ready to go!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your on-foot dreams and help you develop your running/walking skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: Old Dog Racing - Masters Tour
description:
Old Dog Racing presents the Masters Tour. A series of shorter and relatively easier races for intermediate level riders.

All races are categorized by age, because to be completely frank, it’s the best racing you can find on Zwift. If you know, you know. And if you don’t you will! Everyone is welcome to race with us, bring some friends and a nemesis or two.

Come and join the fun; A six week tour, Three start times per week, Wednesdays 5:35 pm Eastern; Thursdays 5:35 pm GMT and Fridays 5:35pm Pacific.
Your best finish position each week will count towards your points total.

Races will be mass start and all riders visible, participants will be issued the Zwift Category kit as an aid to identify which category riders you are currently racing against.

The Categories are divided by age as shown below:
A Under 40 (red) B 40-49 (green) C 50-59 (blue) D 60-69 (yellow) and E 70 and over. (purple)

A word of warning; if you haven’t tried age based (masters) racing before, watch out for the yellow and purple jerseys! Those old guys can be surprisingly fast!

Power ups to help you along your way include: The van, the steamroller, the feather, and aero.

Points awarded to each category in every race are: 25, 20,16,13,11,10,9,8,7,6 and 5 very generous participation points!! (You have to finish!). 

Highest accumulated points in each category wins the tour; you’re going to have to wear an HRM and have a Zwift Power account in order to be awarded points.

Overall Tour winner may be eligible to win an Old Dog Racing Mug! (Details on companion club page.).

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 3/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Race Times (Italian Time): 19:05, 19:25, 19:45, and 20:05.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

For technical support or team registrations, contact the organizers at 

Official Sites: * www.tsezwift.com * www.epicasport.com

name: GXY BLAST OFF! [1.2-1.6WKG] CAT D
description:
Welcome to GXY BLAST OFF!
Please join today's launch, a gentle 60minutes at a beginners / recovery pace.
Blast off by name… but steady as we go, whilst we ride around predominantly flat or slightly undulating courses with
power and speed maintained to suite everyone on this GALAXY no drop ride.
A designated social discord channel is available to just chat or to learn from experienced leaders about how to get the
most out of your journey on the Zwift platform.
We ride as one under the guidance of an experienced leader and sweepers who are there to help and support you.
Their primary aim is of course to keep the group together whilst sharing knowledge and making the ride fun and
enjoyable for everyone.
GXY are a friendly and supportive club who strive to help others succeed. We are looking forward to riding with you
on this, our launchpad ride.
If you want to become a member and join our community to race, ride socially, or both, please come and join ideally
via our Facebook link or by the email below:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/galaxycyclingclub/
https://www.strava.com/clubs/989894
https://www.instagram.com/galaxycyclingclub

name: CSPT club run
description:
Welcome to CSPT; a cycling and running club with a difference. It's a place where members can meet up & have fun without any pressure to perform.

Whether you're short of motivation or inspiration then CSPT is the place for you. Drawing on years of experience from all walks of life and athletic experience we can help to motivate you to achieve whatever your goal is.

With CSPT - "YOU CAN"

This event has no leader, no fence and no rules because that's not what we're about. Stay with the bunch, often we are banded, we'll help you just enjoy being part of the club.

Please join our club : CSPT for further details.

name: Mountain Massif's Mountain Goat Chase Race
description:
This is a race with a difference. The slowest riders will start first with a time advantage over the fastest riders and race up to the top of the climb.  To make it fair, each Category’s advantage will decrease slightly, over the next.

The objective is to ride hard and try and reach the top of the climb, before being caught. This is a unique event because do you form a group and work together on the climb, or do you strike out alone? These decisions will impact the outcome.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

description:
👥 No Limit Cycling Club is a community-led cycling club built around consistency, confidence, and riding together. Riders of all backgrounds and abilities are welcome.

💬 Super Social Thursdays are steady group rides designed to reset after the day. The ride is social and relaxed, with space to chat, sit in the draft, or simply enjoy riding together.

name: Renegade Race
description:
Renegade Race is intended to bring out your inner renegade.. Be fearless
and go for the brake away.

Challenge your opponents with fearless cycling.

We encourage you to race Clean with your true weight, so we all have a hard
and fair race every time we mount the bikes.

We dare you to race with the fastest participants.
So be ready from the start, you will experience hard starts, fearless
climbs and fast middle sections.

heart rate monitors, riding an an inappropriate category,
or riding very unrealistically will be disqualified. Final results will be
available on zwiftpower.com.

name: Hudik Triathlon Time Trial
description:
Hudik Triathlon continues their summer TT-events inside during the colder winter months! 

Join us every Thursday for some high power TT’ing through Tempus Fugit, make the sand blaze and beat your own time or your opponents. 

See you in the pen!

name: Bens Bash
description:
Training ride open to all. The aim of these rides is to provide a regular training ride for all to join in, riding at a steady pace that for some will feel challenging but over time you will get fitter and more comfortable.

Be mindful of your pace and try to keep the group together rather than just ride off on your own - look at this as a way to improve your fitness as well as pick up some skills around riding with others. 

Try not to ride over 3.5 w/kg but if you are feeling frisky - feel free to open the taps with 10 mins to go. 

We will vary the routes so check back regularly.

name: Poursuite de la Lanterne Rouge p/b Velos
description:
Looking for a fun and well supported social ride that will make you stronger? Then join us on Poursuite de la Lanterne Rouge! This event is great for confident D riders looking to step up to something a bit faster, as well as experienced riders who want to test themselves at race pace. We ride together for 45 minutes at 23mph/38kph (2.3w/kg), have a KOM to conquer then a Sprint to warm the legs, then we unleash our Red Beacon to step on the gas and - after a little head start to give our Lanterne Rouge a fighting chance - anyone game for a chase is free to fly. Three chase groups are offered with 3-6 minute deficits to close, and you are guaranteed to get stronger with each attempt to catch! The Yellow Beacon leader will continue at the listed pace the full hour to help those who don’t fancy a chase finish in friendly company. Strong sweep support is available for anyone needing a wheel get back into the leader’s group.
Join our social group at: www.teamvelos.co.uk

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 4/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Race Times (Italian Time): 19:05, 19:25, 19:45, and 20:05.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

For technical support or team registrations, contact the organizers at 

Official Sites: * www.tsezwift.com * www.epicasport.com

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 24
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #385

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: Liv Velocity Social Ride
description:
Winter is coming — and the colder days have arrived!
Every Thursday at 19:15 (CEST) we ride the Liv Velocity Social Ride on Zwift.

Join us for a fun and friendly ladies-only social ride and connect with enthusiastic female cyclists from all around the world.
