name: GRIT - HARD TRUTH
description:
Welcome to the Hard Truth climb. This ride will always cover long climbs on big mountains.
We invite you to take training to the next level by adding this ride to your weekly routine. Steep climbs are hard and long steep climbs are really hard, that is the Hard Truth of this ride.

The ride will start with a friendly group ride format with riders staying together before the big climbs start. Enjoy this social time on the ride before the Hard Truth of the climb arrives.

On climbs, strong riders at the front will push the pace and ride at race pace to compete for the win and the best KOM time. Strong riders at the front will likely output over 5 wpk on the climb.

To keep with a more social ride format, many riders will form a group and ride together on the climb. This social group will likely be using power typical of a Cat B ride. Riders are encouraged to find a group and ride together to help each other survive the Hard Truth of these big climbs.

name: KISS at Base Training Ride
description:
Join us to work on your endurance and power output at your aerobic threshold (AT) in Zone 2. The exercise will give you endurance and increased performance using fat as energy. A well-developed AT can give you better race performance increase the amount of time before your body uses glycogen stores.

We are now offering three separate paced rides to better accommodate various fitness levels.

The B Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 3.2 - 3.99 w/kg.
The C Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.5 - 3.19 w/kg.
The D Cat is for riders with Zone 2 between 2.2 - 2.49 w/kg.

Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

So turn on your graph (press G on computer keyboard or select it from on-screen menu in iOS and Android) and paint it blue. Give the body a good foundation for Zwift racing. Discord server Link: https://discord.gg/kBmXhY2

Remember this when you approach hills and inclines along the way. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob.

name: CRYO-GEN Peaky Friday.
description:
The CRYO-GEN Peaky Friday Ride is a social ride for everyone who enjoys a
good climb, with plenty of rolling routes mixed in for variety. Join us
each Friday for a friendly, social spin that offers something for every
type of rider.

Whether you’re a steady D cat rider looking for supportive group miles and
a bit of extra hill practice, or a stronger rider after a fun, relaxed spin
with the option to stretch your legs on the climbs, you’ll find your place
on The Peaky Friday Ride. It’s all about teamwork, good vibes, and enjoying
the ride together, wherever the road takes us!

The yellow beacon will pace at around 2.2 w/kg on the flats and 2.5 w/kg on
the climbs. At times, we’ll turn off the fence and open up a free-pace
section, giving everyone the chance to push harder if they wish, or simply
ride steady with the yellow beacon, who will always maintain the advertised
pace. We regroup at the KOM banner, with plenty of notice before the fence
is reactivated, so everyone can come back together and enjoy the ride as a
group.

For those who enjoy a touch of luxury, we even have a Limo Service run by a
member of the sweep team! This friendly gruppetto offers a more relaxed
pace when needed, ensuring everyone can enjoy the ride at their own rhythm.

All we ask is that you respect the ride leader, help where you can, and
keep it fun and social. We hope you will join us on the hills!

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the
first time to ensure that their health should always take precedence over
completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP

NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet)
contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

description:
Two movements. One iconic kit. One unforgettable ride.

This W100 weekend, we are celebrating the Rapha W100 x Watch the Femmes collaboration—created to celebrate the movement and inspire the biggest Rapha Women's 100 yet.

This isn't just about riding 100 km. It's about finding a wheel to chase. Celebrating every effort. And discovering how far you can go when women ride together and push each other further.

name: DWGZ — Volata
description:
DWGZ — Volata

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Volata — Italian for a bunch sprint, the mad dash to the line — is our Friday sprint session. Over a full 90 minutes, expect multiple sprint efforts built into the ride: short, explosive bursts of max power followed by recovery, then back at it again. It's less about steady pacing and more about repeatedly finding that extra gear, testing your legs against the group, and having some fun with it before the weekend hits.

Whether you're sharpening your top-end power, working on positioning before the line, or just want to test yourself against friendly wheels, this one's for you.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect explosive efforts, plenty of recovery, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.  Clip in, find your kick, and sprint into the weekend with us.

description:
Welcome to USMeS - Friday Formation 1.8 – 2.2w/kg Ride
Line up, loosen up, and enjoy a ride that lets you have a little fun while keeping it tight. This is a chance to wake the legs, enjoy the group, and set yourself up either for Rapid Fire, immediately after this ride, or to roll into the weekend feeling sharp instead of flat.
Ride it smooth -- ride it smart -- and -- ride it together.

Respect the leader. Respect the pace. Protect the group.

name: TGIF DIRTy Goats
description:
If screaming legs and burning lungs make you smile. Welcome to DIRTy Goats.

Every Friday, we encourage you to leave the flats behind and embrace the challenge of the weekly KOM.

An inclusive ride for all wanting to improve their mental toughness, develop climbing technique or simply badge hunt the routes you frequently choose to avoid. DIRTy Goats is the team to motivate you out of your comfort zone.

If you are daunted by the DIRTy Goats, Yellow beacon will stay within the ride limits. Our pace is based on a 75kg rider, riding 2.6w/kg or 195 watts on the flat, and 3.5w/kg or 260 watts on the climb. Lighter and heavier riders wanting to pace with the Leader are asked to adjust their power to work together.

Each ride will target 1000 vertical meters. This is not always achievable within our 90 minute ride, but the team will often keep rolling until we hit our goal.

Stronger riders are encouraged to work with the beacons to help the group. But if you really must fly, we ask that you move away quickly during the warm-up to avoid pulling the front.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers. This group has grown and brought like-minded moms and dads together who love to make time for Zwift around work and family.

Please join us on discord: https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

And Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZWIFTDIRT

This 40 minute group ride will rotate different routes for those badge hunters out there. Lead beacon will ride around 2.0, but come for the journey and unlock a kit along the way. 
Bike MS Season if right around the corner, so let's connect over a ride as we prepare for the adventures ahead. Multiple Sclerosis does not stop, so neither will we as we ride together for this great cause.
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2023 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowering all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use Zwift24 for a discount on your Bike MS Ride entry fee.

name: ZZRC Latte 2-2.5 Group Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Latte 2-2.5. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

description:
Welcome to Rapid Fire Friday, where we turn up the heat after our TGIF warm-up ride! This is a sprint-focused session designed to sharpen your top-end power and inject a little adrenaline into your week.

 

✅ Pace: 2.2–2.8 w/kg average between sprints
✅ Duration: ~60 minutes of spicy intervals
✅ Sprints: Frequent, all-out efforts—fence drops for each sprint
✅ Fence: Will be in use between sprints to keep the group tight – please fall in quickly after each effort

 

Ride Format:

Steady pace cruising between sprint segments
Sprint calls will be announced in advance
Fence will come down for each sprint – then we regroup promptly behind the beacon
 

Expectations:
⚡ Bring your A-game for the sprints
⚡ Recover quickly and maintain discipline between efforts
⚡ Respect the Leader (or the fence) and the group – this keeps the ride smooth for everyone

 

Whether you’re chasing a PR or sharpening your legs for race day, Rapid Fire Friday is the perfect way to wrap up your week with purpose and power.

Fall in. Lock on. Fire away.

description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Zwift Runner's Walk/Run Intervals
description:
PLEASE DO NOT ENTER THIS EVENT UNLESS YOU ARE HAPPY TO FOLLOW THE SPECIFIC RUN INSTRUCTIONS BELOW.

This event is designed to be run as a group with the emphasis on all finishing together.  

The run will be formed of a series of Walk/Run intervals.  The run interval will be for 90 seconds at at speed of 5mph (8kph) which is a pace of 12:00 min/mile (7:30min/km).  The walk will be for 60 seconds at 3.2mph (5.1kph) which is a pace of 11:45 min/km 18:45 min/mile (11:45 min/km).

When there is a group leader present, the workout may be spiced up a bit.  Expect treadmill incline challenges, speed surges, and mini chases using the specified intervals as a base pace.   You can choose to just stick to the base workout or join in on the fun of the challenge.  

Every effort will be made to try to keep the group together.

Please get your treadmills to speed and start running 30 seconds before the event start to ensure we all get off the line together.  Don't worry, you can run in the start pen on a virtual treadmill.

NOTE - If joining this event it is important that you are willing to compromise your own speed to ensure everyone running has an enjoyable experience.

name: Ascenders Rise & Shine Event - Team Pursuit
description:
Team #1 will roll out at the regularly scheduled time (09:05 EST/13:05 UTC)
and maintain the advertised pace (21-23mph/34-38kph on flat sections. If
the road tilts up greater than 0%, Yellow Beacon will pace at 1.8-2.0

name: Bicycle Way of Life Fri-yay Ride
description:
YAY! You finished the week. No need to race into the weekend, start it off with an easy ride, socializing and celebrating the Bicycle Way of Life.  Join us every Friday to sip your coffee or tea… hey it's morning for us… and socialize. Talk about bikes, about your favorite roads or trails. Perhaps even share a cake recipe?

The average speed will be 21 mph-23 mph (34 kph-36 kph) flat sections, dropping on climbs as the ride lead targets an effort of 1.8 to 1.9 wpk. The lead will keep the pace and stronger riders will be there to help as needed.  We always plan to provide lead and sweep support, but there will be times where that will not be the case.  You are encouraged to pace with the ride leader/yellow beacon, but if they are not able to make the ride, or if you find the pace too quick, drop off, group up, work together with those around you.  Teamwork makes the ride work.  

Want to know more about us? Bicycle Way of Life (bicycleway.com) is a local bike store chain in Eugene, Oregon. We encourage new and experienced riders to support each other indoors and out, fixing trails or just their bikes.
Interact and find more info. by joining our FB group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/bwolzwift
Look us up on Strava https://www.strava.com/clubs/bicycleway-com, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/bicyclewayoflife/, and Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bicycleway/

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: DBR Friday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Friday Race.
All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>

Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - ITT
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Team DRAFT Friday Race
description:
WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You can not race in the D category.

Welcome to the Friday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!

We encourage all participants to head over to zwiftpower.com and register. Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration and agreed to the sharing conditions will not be included in the official results.

To make this race as fair as possible, we require that all riders wear a heart rate monitor, use a power meter and/or smart trainer, and choose the appropriate race category for your ability. Riding in an inappropriate category will lead to your disqualification.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

description:
Your weekend starts here with the SYN—hold the wheel for 60 minutes, then race to the line. Every Friday the SYN Global Cycling Club brings you the Chasing SYNers Ride—a weekly community spin with a spicy finish. 

60MIN GROUP RIDE + RACE TO THE FINISH
The first hour is a solid C-paced group ride, guided and controlled by our SYN ride leaders to keep the pack smooth and tight. After roughly 60 minutes, the doors open. The final block is a free race to the line—sometimes a climb, sometimes a crit-style sprint, always a chance to empty the tank. It’s the perfect way to kick the weekend wide open with a serious push.

UNLOCK THE SYNDICATE CLUB KIT
Finish our Chasing SYNers Ride on Zwift and unlock the Inverted SYN Kit (black jersey, white bib) in your garage, so you can wear the colors of our cycling club in any other ride on Zwift.

name: ZTPL Cycling Club 100km ride with Wintertal
description:
☀️Weszliśmy w sezon wiosenno-letni☀️
Część naszych eventów zostaje w kalendarzu, ale może zdarzyć się tak że nie będzie na nich naszych liderów jazd.
Jeśli tak się zdarzy, gorąca prośba do Was o jazdę wg. założeń danego eventu.
Nasze eventy i liderzy ZTPL Cycling Club wrócą ponownie na jesień 2026.
Póki co RIDE ON i korzystajcie z pogody, a jeśli nie możecie to bawcie się dobrze podczas naszych eventów.

Zapraszamy na wspólny event z ZTPL Cycling Club oraz naszego partnera WINTERTAL producenta odzieży casualowej dla rowerzystów.
◾️Nasze casualowe koszulki znajdziecie u Wintertala: https://wintertal.com/pl/133-ztplcc

Pamiętajcie o wyborze właściwej grupy.
Nasza piątkowa “100tka” pomoże Wam nauczyć się jeździć długo w określonych wartościach w/kg.
Tempo będzie w 99% procentach równe, ale to ostatecznie od liderów zależy czy pojawią się jakieś akcenty np na podjazdach. Podane założenia w/kg dotyczą średniej wartości z całej jazdy.

Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

◾️Grupa D jest grupą początkującą i będzie pokonywać 50 kilometrów. Tempo jest spokojne, uczymy się jazdy w grupie, jest czas żeby porozmawiać.
◾️ Grupa C przeznaczona jest dla średnio zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 2.6-3.2 w/kg z przodu peletonu (możliwe akcenty).
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w granicach 2.8w/kg to nie będzie grupa dla Was
◾️ Grupa B przeznaczona jest dla bardziej zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 3-3.5w/kg dodatkowo mogą wystąpić akcenty.
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w okolicach 3.2w/kg to może nie być grupa dla Was
◾️ Jeśli chcecie przejechać jazdę w tempie Coffee Ride wybierzcie o jedną grupę niżej niż sugeruje wam wasze FTP lub zwiftpower :)

◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.
Proszę stosujcie się do poleceń lidera!
Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.

eventSubgroups.name: ZTPL Cycling Club 100km ride with Wintertal (B)
eventSubgroups.description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny event z ZTPL Cycling Club. Pamiętajcie o wyborze właściwej grupy.
Nasza piątkowa "100tka" pomoże Wam nauczyć się jeździć długo w określonych wartościach w/kg.
Tempo będzie w 99% procentach równe, ale to ostatecznie od liderów zależy czy pojawią się jakieś akcenty np na podjazdach. Podane założenia w/kg dotyczą średniej wartości z całej jazdy.

Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

◾️Grupa D jest grupą początkującą i będzie pokonywać 50 kilometrów. Tempo jest spokojne, uczymy się jazdy w grupie, jest czas żeby porozmawiać.
◾️ Grupa C przeznaczona jest dla średnio zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 2.8-3.2w/kg z przodu peletonu (możliwe akcenty).
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w granicach 2.8w/kg to nie będzie grupa dla Was
◾️ Grupa B przeznaczona jest dla bardziej zaawansowanych. Tempo będzie oscylować w okolicach 3.2-4.0w/kg dodatkowo mogą wystąpić akcenty.
Ważne: Jeśli wasze FTP jest w okolicach 3.2w/kg to może nie być grupa dla Was
◾️ Jeśli chcecie przejechać jazdę w tempie Coffee Ride wybierzcie o jedną grupę niżej niż sugeruje wam wasze FTP lub zwiftpower :)

◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.
Proszę stosujcie się do poleceń lidera! Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.

◾️ Jeśli chcecie sprawić sobie naszą teamową koszulkę ZTPL Cycling Club to będzie szansa podczas kolejnego Pre-Ordera, więcej informacji znajdziecie na http://ztpl.cc/stroje-ztpl-cc/

name: Rapha Women's 100
description:
Two movements. One iconic kit. One unforgettable ride.

This W100 weekend, we are celebrating the Rapha W100 x Watch the Femmes collaboration—created to celebrate the movement and inspire the biggest Rapha Women's 100 yet.

This isn't just about riding 100 km. It's about finding a wheel to chase. Celebrating every effort. And discovering how far you can go when women ride together and push each other further.

Take on 100 km your way—indoors on Zwift or outdoors -  to unlock the exclusive Rapha Women's 100 in-game kit. See the full collection here: https://www.rapha.cc/us/en/shop/womens-100

VIEW RESULTS: https://www.zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingaug2026

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Urumaze
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at <http://www.zwiftpower.com/> http://www.zwiftpower.com
